questions.q: In 'The Mole and His Mother', what did the little Mole think the frankincense was?
choices: A pebble
Some bread
A flower
A worm

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Mole and His Mother'?
choices: Boast of one thing and you will be found lacking in that and more
Moles can see very well if they only open their eyes to the light
Always listen to your mother, even when you think she is wrong
Frankincense smells bad to moles who live under the ground
questions.evidence: Boast of one thing and you will be found lacking

questions.q: In 'The North Wind and the Sun', what contest did they agree on?
choices: Whoever could make the Traveler take off his cloak
Whoever could blow down the tallest tree in the land
Whoever could make it rain on the dusty road first
Whoever could reach the Traveler on the road first
questions.evidence: he is the stronger who can strip that Traveler of his cloak

questions.q: In 'The North Wind and the Sun', what did the Traveler do when the North Wind blew harder?
choices: Held his cloak tighter
Took off his cloak
Ran off into the woods
Sat down under a tree
questions.evidence: the tighter he held it to him

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The North Wind and the Sun'?
choices: Gentleness and kind persuasion win where force fails
The North Wind is always stronger than the warm Sun
Always wear a warm cloak when you go out walking
The Sun is much too hot for anyone to walk under
questions.evidence: Gentleness and kind persuasion win where force and bluster fail.

questions.q: In 'The Hare and His Ears', why did the Hare run away even though he had no horns?
choices: He feared the Lion would call his long ears horns
The Cricket told him to go away to a new place
He wanted to find a new home in a quieter field
The Goat with long horns chased him out of the field
questions.evidence: He will certainly make out that my ears are horns

questions.q: In 'The Wolves and the Sheep', how did the Wolves trick the Sheep?
choices: They said to send the Dogs away so they could be friends
They dressed up in sheepskins so they looked like Sheep
They hid in the tall grass until the Dogs were asleep
They brought the Sheep fresh green grass as a gift
questions.evidence: Send them away and you will see what good friends we shall become.

questions.q: In 'The Cock and the Fox', why did the Fox say he was going to visit a sick relative?
choices: To trick the Cock so he would not tell anyone
Because his relative really was very sick
To ask the Cock for help in finding medicine
To make the Cock feel sad and come down to him
questions.evidence: But please do not tell anybody about it.
